name: kimi-td-memory
description: TencentDB-Agent-Memory (td-memory) integration for Kimi Code CLI. Provides recall/search tools and works with an external watcher for automatic conversation capture.

tools.name: td_search_memories
tools.description: Search L1 atomic memories in td-memory. Use this to recall distilled facts, decisions, and project context from past sessions.

query.description: Search query — natural language or keywords

session_key.description: Optional td-memory session key. If omitted, derived from current project directory.

tools.name: td_search_conversations
tools.description: Search L0 raw conversations in td-memory. Use this to find exact past dialogues or when L1 memories are insufficient.

query.description: Search query — natural language or keywords

session_key.description: Optional td-memory session key. If omitted, derived from current project directory.

tools.name: td_capture
tools.description: Manually capture a user/assistant turn into td-memory. Usually not needed because the watcher captures automatically.

session_key.description: Optional td-memory session key. If omitted, derived from current project directory.

tools.name: td_end_session
tools.description: Flush the current session and trigger L1/L2/L3 extraction immediately. Use at the end of a significant discussion or before switching topics.

session_key.description: Optional td-memory session key. If omitted, derived from current project directory.

tools.name: td_health
tools.description: Check whether the TDAI Gateway is reachable.

tools.name: td_status
tools.description: Show kimi-td-memory status: gateway URL and watcher process state.
